fact: On 13 April 2025 the Tax Chamber launched its electronic collection and payment programme (Eisali e-receipt) in Red Sea State, with bills paid through selected banks (Faisal Islamic Bank, Omdurman National Bank) and other safe states to follow.
title: ديوان الضرائب يدشن برنامج التحصيل والسداد الالكتروني
publisher: Sudan News Agency (SUNA), via Sudan Akhbar
